calculator_engine: function intraday(buy,sell,qty,brok){const gross=(sell-buy)*qty;const stt=sell*qty*0.00025;const exchCharge=(buy+sell)*qty*0.0000345;const gst=(brok*2+exchCharge)*0.18;const sebi=(buy+sell)*qty*0.0000001;const total=brok*2+stt+exchCharge+gst+sebi;const netPL=gross-total;const tax=netPL>0?netPL*0.20:0;return{gross,total,netPL,netAfterTax:netPL-tax,returnPct:(netPL/(buy*qty)*100).toFixed(2)};}
